criteria: Down 10%+ over 1 month, P/E and Forward P/E under 22, PEG under 2, net profit margin over 3%, return on equity over 5%, RSI under 45, relative volume under 1x 30-day average, market cap over $300M — top 7 by market cap
disclaimer: Informational screener only, not investment advice. Data from live market feed. Not a recommendation to buy or sell any security.

cards.name: Itau Unibanco
cards.why: Brazil's largest private bank. Results were roughly in line on Aug 4, yet shares are down 10% — looks more like broader Brazilian market pressure than the print itself.

cards.name: Banco Bradesco
cards.why: One of Brazil's largest banks and insurers. Results were roughly in line on Aug 5, but shares are down 10% — again looks more sector/macro-driven than earnings-driven.

cards.name: Trade Desk
cards.why: Runs a programmatic ad-buying platform. Missed estimates by 8% on Aug 6, and shares are down 24% since — a direct reaction to the miss.

cards.name: Dave
cards.why: Runs a digital banking app with cash-advance and budgeting tools. Beat estimates by 12% on Aug 5, yet shares dropped 18% — guidance likely weighed more than the print.

cards.name: Driven Brands
cards.why: Provides auto services through brands like Take 5 Oil Change and Meineke. Beat estimates by 12% on Aug 6, yet shares fell 13% — another beat that guidance or sector jitters overshadowed.

cards.name: Blue Bird
cards.why: Makes school buses, including electric models. Results were basically in line on Aug 5, but shares are down 12% — the move looks more sector- or guidance-driven than tied to the print.

cards.name: PicPay
cards.why: Runs digital banking and payments in Brazil. No earnings report in the past month — the last print (Jun 2) missed badly, and the next isn't until Aug 24. This slide looks like lingering fallout or sector pressure, not a fresh catalyst.
